name: Agent Warden
author: VanillaGreen
description: A shield in the bar that shows whether the agent warden vsys ships keeps your AI agents within their memory and task limits, a small panel with what needs a look and a link that opens vsys, and one notification when something starts to need a look. It reads the warden's status and never changes an agent itself.

showCount.label: Show a count
showCount.description: Show beside the shield how many agents run, or how many things need a look

hideWhenIdle.label: Hide when idle
hideWhenIdle.description: Hide the shield while no agent runs and nothing needs a look

notify.label: Notifications
notify.description: Which notifications Agent Warden sends: problems only, also each move back into limits, or none

warden.hint: Keeps AI agents within their memory and task limits
